_README: Roles established by targeted web research, one person at a time. Keys are matched on surname + first-name initial (see author_key in scripts/build_docs.py), so the exact spelling of the given name here does not matter. Where a source did not state a job title explicitly and the role is deduced from authorship position, tenure and institutional affiliation, the entry says '(inferred)'. Entries marked 'collaborator' are people who show up frequently in the co-authorship data but who ran their own group or worked at another institute - they are listed so they are not mistaken for lab members.
